title: IPGD in Law (Level 7)
description: The International Postgraduate Diploma in Law provides an advanced understanding of key legal principles, systems, and practices relevant to modern global contexts.
longDescription: This diploma explores the foundations of legal systems, corporate governance, and professional legal practice. Learners gain in-depth knowledge of contract law, dispute resolution, and judicial processes. It also covers property and land law, principles of equity, and the frameworks governing public and European law. The course emphasizes analytical reasoning, critical thinking, and ethical decision-making in legal practice. Designed for aspiring legal professionals, it prepares learners for roles in law firms, corporations, and regulatory bodies. We don’t just give you the theory; we ensure you learn how to apply it in your working life immediately, with case studies, webinars, and business simulations, and 100% project-based. The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Law allows you to achieve the qualification in 6 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. This programme aims to deliver practical and realistic solutions to the challenges in law, which in turn is supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.
courseDetails: Mode of Study: Blended Assessment: Research-based Assignments The objective of the International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Law is to enhance learners’ understanding of key legal principles and develop the skills required to apply and manage legal processes effectively. This qualification reflects contemporary practices across various fields of law, enabling learners to expand their advanced legal knowledge and analytical capabilities. It prepares individuals to navigate complex legal frameworks, provide informed legal guidance, and contribute to effective decision-making within professional legal and corporate environments. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme consists of 7 modules with 5 ECTS each and a Graduation Project with 25 ECTS.

accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up Upon completing this course, students can complete a Master's degree programme from one of our Partner Universities. The top-up programme can be studied online. The top-up may comprise the study of a few modules or a final dissertation project. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) For more details and partner Universities offering the topup, please speak to our student advisors.
workshops: Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
